description: Update source code of an existing ABAP service definition. Locks, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates.

activate.description: Activate service definition after update. Default: true.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name. Must exist in the system.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Optional if object is local or already in transport.

name: UpdateServiceDefinition
